CheckboxRoot.description: The box: a native `<input type="checkbox">`. Its children are rendered after it, as its siblings. Style it with `appearance: none`, `:checked`, `:indeterminate`, `:disabled`, `:focus-visible` and `:user-invalid`.

props.checked: Whether the box is checked. Pass it with `onCheckedChange` to control the box.
props.defaultChecked: Whether the box is checked at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onCheckedChange: Called with the new state when the user checks or clears the box.
props.indeterminate: Shows the box as neither checked nor unchecked; `:indeterminate` matches it. A press clears it and toggles the box, as the browser does, and the box is set back to indeterminate while this stays true.
props.disabled: Disables the box natively: it can't be focused or pressed, and `:disabled` matches it.
props.readOnly: Keeps the box focusable but cancels a press or Space, so its state doesn't change. Sets `aria-readonly` and `data-readonly`.
props.required: Sets the native `required` attribute: the box must be checked for its form, or its Field, to be valid.
props.name: The name the box submits `value` under while it is checked. Inside a FieldRoot, the field's `name` is used when this is absent.
props.value: What the box submits with its form while checked; the browser's default is `"on"`. Inside a CheckboxGroup, the value the group's list holds while this box is checked.
props.parent: Inside a CheckboxGroup with `allValues`: makes this the box that checks or clears all the others. It is checked when all are, indeterminate when some are, and submits nothing.

dataAttributes.data-parent: Present on the parent box of a CheckboxGroup.
dataAttributes.data-invalid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.
dataAttributes.data-valid: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.
dataAttributes.data-touched: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the box has been focused and left.
dataAttributes.data-dirty: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the box's state differs from its initial one.
dataAttributes.data-filled: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the box is checked.

CheckboxIndicator.description: A mark shown beside the box, always in the document. Place it in CheckboxRoot, where it is the box's next sibling, and show it with `.Checkbox:checked + .Indicator` and `.Checkbox:indeterminate + .Indicator`. It is `aria-hidden`: the box's own state is what assistive technology gets.
